description: Extract the dominant colour palette (5, 8 or 12 colours) with HEX, RGB and HSL values plus CSS custom properties from any image, and optionally sample the exact colour (or 5x5 average) at a given (x%, y%) coordinate. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.002/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/image-color-picker.

average5x5.description: Average a 5x5 pixel area around (x, y)

fileContent.description: The file as base64 (a data: URI is fine)

fileName.description: File name with extension, e.g. report.pdf

x.description: Optional horizontal sample point (% from left, 0-100)

y.description: Optional vertical sample point (% from top, 0-100)

name: image_color_picker
title: Image Color Picker API - dominant HEX/RGB/HSL palette & exact pixel sampler
